claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_creature_searches
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The camouflage mechanic requires a trigger that fires when a creature takes the Search action on the area, paired with an ability_check_gate (Wis Perception or Survival vs spell save DC). The existing on_creature_studies trigger maps to the Study standard action, not Search. Both are distinct standard action kinds in SRD 5.2.1.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature that can't see the area when the spell is cast must take a Search action and succeed on a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.
